title: Spatiotemporal AI-based modeling of gene regulation and variant effects in the developing human brain using Seal
title_zh: 基于 Seal 的人类大脑发育中基因调控和变异效应的时空 AI 建模
abstract: Understanding how genetic variation shapes gene regulation in the developing human brain remains a central challenge in neuroscience, particularly in transient cell types and developmental stages where data are limited. We present Seal, an interpretable artificial intelligence (AI) transfer learning framework for genome-based modeling of gene expression and variant effects with spatiotemporal resolution across 26 regions, 30 cell types and 7 developmental stages. Seal predictions provide mechanistic interpretation by linking variants to transcriptional regulators in a spatiotemporal context. Applying Seal to genome-wide association studies, we identify shared and distinct regulatory architectures across six neuropsychiatric conditions that align with clinical trajectories. In the Simons Simplex Collection autism cohort whole-genome data, Seal uncovers a significant burden of de novo regulatory variants in transient fetal excitatory neurons, revealing cell-type-specific and stage-specific effects. By connecting genetic variation to spatiotemporal regulatory programs, Seal offers a general framework for uncovering mechanisms of human brain development and disease. Seal is an artificial intelligence framework that predicts the effects of regulatory variants in 802 brain cell states, revealing spatiotemporal gene regulation and pinpointing cell types and developmental stages associated with neuropsychiatric conditions.
abstract_zh: 理解遗传变异如何在发育中的人类大脑中调控基因表达仍然是神经科学的核心挑战，特别是在数据有限的瞬时细胞类型和发育阶段。我们提出了 Seal，一个可解释的转移学习人工智能框架，用于基于基因组的基因表达和变异效应建模，在26个区域、30种细胞类型和7个发育阶段实现时空分辨率。Seal 的预测通过在时空背景下将变异链接到转录调控因子，提供机制解释。将 Seal 应用于全基因组关联研究，我们识别出六种精神疾病在监测轨迹上一致的共享和独特的调控架构。在 Simons Simplex Collection 自闭症队列的全基因组数据中，Seal 发现了瞬时胚状兴奋性神经元中去调控变异的显著富集，揭示了细胞类型特异性和阶段特异性效应。通过将遗传变异与时空调控程序相连接，Seal 为揭示人类大脑发育和疾病机制提供了一个通用框架。Seal 是一个预测 802 种脑细胞状态中监管变异效应的人工智能框架，揭示了时空基因调控并定位了与精神疾病相关的细胞类型和发育阶段。
